note: 22 Nov 2026 full codebase review & Wave 1 fixes complete (30 fixed, 42 open; all 7 Critical fixed).

items.title: Fixed ResourceEncryptionObfuscator typed loader IL stack imbalance (nsNull Nop).
Fixed VM R4/R8 stack widening (BoxReturn, Bin, comparisons, CallVm, DoRet, SetLoc, SetArg).
Fixed ControlFlowObfuscator opaque predicates (SimplifyBranches/OptimizeBranches, CFG zero-depth sites, MaxStack).
Fixed ControlFlowFlattener CFG BFS stack-depth propagation & MaxStack.
Fixed AntiTamperObfuscator single-file ProcessPath CLR DataDirectory guard + SHA256 try/finally disposal.
Fixed AntiDumpObfuscator x86 ret 0x1C/xor eax,eax, ARM64 guard, LoadLibraryExW, UIntPtr, and VirtualProtect restore.
Fixed build/ObfySetup.iss {sys}\taskkill.exe in PrepareToInstall/[UninstallRun] and EnvAddPath RegValueExists guard.
Update PRIVACY.md and /obfy/privacy for remaining Core symbol/resource/watermark logs and packer Trace.WriteLine paths.
Close gaps in packed apps (foreground threads, AppDomain.UnhandledException, GetEntryAssembly, plus [STAThread] in B-105).
Ask before replacing unsaved (dirty) settings on open-configuration or config drop.
ClosedSetProcessor rewrites InternalsVisibleTo(PublicKey=...) on closed-set signing.
RunCoordinator.WhileIdle closes files.remove and sibling quick-mutation vs run-start races.
SourceStringEncryptor decodes raw interpolated text ({{{{ and \u007b\u007b/\x7b) with tests.
Make VS extension build a .vsix (Microsoft.VsSDK.targets), align 1.3.0 manifest version, fix README, and run live in VS.
Fixed ClosedSetProcessor HasEntryPoint use-after-dispose when packing is enabled.
Fixed transitive BFS entry-point reachability in ClosedSetProcessor & SolutionAnalyzer.
Partial: MergeAndObfuscateAsync now preserves InputPath (inputList[0]) for reporting; remaining: merge incremental caching and non-merged sibling dependency embedding.
Fixed closed-set combined reports N× symbol/warning duplication and aggregated FileInfo.
Fixed WildcardMatcher ReDoS (RegexOptions.NonBacktracking) + bounded 4096 cache.
Fixed ObfuscationAttributeRules case-insensitive feature normalization + enclosing outer type walk.
Fixed SymbolRenamingObfuscator pre-mutation parameter collection, namespace exclusions, and PreservePublicApi NestedPublic/protected.
Qualified System.Reflection.Assembly & System.Resources.ResourceManager signature matching.
Fixed ReferenceProxyObfuscator enclosing type visibility + skipped caller-sensitive BCL APIs.
Fixed Roslyn SourceControlFlowObfuscator (pattern vars, nested labels, unique tick var, no unreachable CS0162).
Fixed Roslyn SourceSymbolRenamer (record positional properties, duck-typed C# patterns, partial/override params).
Fixed VM IntPtr/UIntPtr screening in VmEncoder.
Packed hosts never honor [STAThread], breaking WPF & STA WinForms apps.

Partial: RunCoordinator Start() _runTask, Finish() snapshot, _publishGate I/O removal, and quick-mutation WhileIdle fixed; remaining: async OS dialog TOCTOU (PickFiles/OpenConfig/PickOutputFolder/PickSymbolMap/PickSigningKey).
Fixed CLI FillNullSections, duplicate JSON keys (JsonDocument), and Wizard summary order / PreservePublicApiChoice / overwrite loop.
Fixed FilesPage empty-state notices; disabled ProtectionPage & Ctrl+O/Ctrl+L during active run.

Fixed VS CliArgumentBuilder.Quote dash-prefixed paths, ObfySettingsJson duplicate keys/malformed JSON, SettingsDialogViewModel Custom preservation, and OpenSettingsCommand/TogglePostBuildCommand error handling.
Publish 2.0.0, then remove the temporary release notes and update README installer link.
Point the Microsoft Store privacy URL at brudvik.com/obfy/privacy and verify shipped version.
Update GitHub Actions that still target Node 20 (Dependabot PRs #28, #29, #30).
Gate NuGet publish behind a GitHub Environment with required reviewers.
Pin the SHA-512 hash of the native host pack download in NativeHost build.ps1.
Check where the Store (MSIX) app writes its logs, preferences, and WebView2 profile.
Clear stale files from Assets on build and require frontend build for publish.
Pin the .NET SDK (global.json) and lock NuGet packages (nuget.config + lock files).

Make "Open the full guide online" on the Guide screen open the matching section.

Sign the portable managed launcher after packing when strong-name signing is enabled.

Decide whether watermark.id may appear in logs or update privacy wording.
Decide whether the CLI should warn or require a flag before replacing an input outside MSBuild.

Test and document what nameof gives after source symbol renaming.

Send frontend ErrorBoundary error types to the host log.
Verify PublishTrimmed apps with the injected framework references.
